rationale: The agent file nearly copies the gold file, but it adds a local `List.Perm := True` in both namespaces, so `array_is_permutation_prop` and `build_permutation_prop` (and therefore their `Post_prop` conjuncts) become trivially true. The real permutation guarantees survive only as standalone lemmas (`maxHeapify_perm_fuel`, `buildMaxHeap_perm`), while every other gold theorem is preserved unchanged.
